justification: Inspected [byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bind/MethodDelegationBinder.java](...#L951) and [byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bind/MethodDelegationBinderAmbiguityResolverChainTest.java](...#L1). `Compound` is a small nested utility with one field (`ambiguityResolvers`), two constructors, and one `resolve` method; its responsibility is limited to flattening/filtering a resolver chain and iterating until a non-UNKNOWN resolution is found. The tests confirm only this sequential chaining behavior. There is no evidence of excessive size, many public methods, or multiple unrelated responsibilities, so insufficient modularization is not present.
